user_query: trass gmail with terms mgm last 1 month

intent.goal: find emails in Trass Gmail that mention MGM

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    g.subject,
    g.sender_name,
    g.sender_email,
    g.body_snippet
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%mgm%' 
    OR g.sender_name LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR g.sender_email LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%'
)
AND (g.email_date >= date('now', '-1 month') OR u.created_time >= date('now', '-1 month'))
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200
